description: Montgomery County Ride On Routes is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. This layer shows all Montgomery County Ride On bus routes including all variations. The information was retrieved from January 2016 MCRO GTFS files. The GTFS file was converted to ArcGIS format by CMRT. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are maryland open data, montgomery county, mcro gtfs, maryland, layer shows. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
